name: design-kit
description: The Claude Desktop design picker as local, own-your-files skills: /design-kit:slides (an HTML deck; PDF and PPTX by script), /design-kit:design (2-4 artboard directions with knobs), /design-kit:in-codebase (the design rendered with the project's OWN components; handoff-bundle intake with a token-drift table), /design-kit:system (tokens, typefaces and components into design-system/), /design-kit:artifact (a self-contained page, shared on consent), /design-kit:motion (a static design animated into a looping showcase) and /design-kit:film (a beat-synced product film from a brief, with checks by script). One localhost URL under .design-kit/; nothing leaves the machine unless you say yes.

cc_design_kit_pick.title: Board pick notice (CC_DESIGN_KIT_PICK)
cc_design_kit_pick.description: Tell the session when an artboard picked on a design-kit board is waiting: on or off. The environment variable CC_DESIGN_KIT_PICK overrides this.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.
